title: Lane lint parses each changed Python file at the version CI pins
why: On #1973 a builder wrote a nested same-quote f-string (merge/merge.py:331), which only Python 3.12 and later accept. CI pins 3.11; local tests on 3.13 passed, and the round-2 reviewer caught it only by running python3.11 by hand (lane lint-uses-pinned-tools, 07:24 CST Nov 8).
note: Done check: a red test where lane lint fails a changed .py file that 3.11 cannot parse (ast.parse with feature_version read from the CI pin, not a copied number), and a control where 3.11-valid code passes. A fix for a found gap (item 410 a). Slug from the lane; title by triage.
